description: This file defines the CursoService class, providing core business logic for managing Curso entities, including creation, updating, deletion, and retrieval of courses within the application.

classes.name: CursoService
classes.description: Service class responsible for handling business logic related to 'Curso' entities, such as creation, update, retrieval, and deletion.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new Curso entity from CursoDto, throws exception if a course with the same name already exists.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing Curso entity with data from a given Curso object.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the provided Curso entity from the repository.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all Curso entities from the repository.
